title: Discussion — Telepathy Tapes - The Hill vs Mallworld
content: Has anyone been listening to the telepathy tapes? Do you think we are accessing a world similar to “the Hill”? My mall world is not peaceful and joyful though. I often have lucid dreams but for whatever reason I don’t ever become lucid in mallworld. I wish I could and start interacting with the people there more and realize it so we could communicate there.
